literal_meaning: গড়িয়ে পড়া বা আলস্যের অবস্থা (rolling or lounging lazily)
figurative_meaning_en: The attitude of unwillingly avoiding or shirking responsibilities due to laziness
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কাজে গড়িমসি করে সময় নষ্ট করে।
গড়িমসি ছেড়ে উঠে পড়ো, দেরি হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He wastes time by procrastinating on his work.
Stop lazing around and get up, or you'll be late.
history: Originating from the imagery of rolling lazily in bed, reflecting traditional Bengali rural life where idleness was frowned upon in agrarian society.
note: The idiom captures a cultural disdain for sloth in daily routines.
